name: Simplicial Partition Isosurfacing
aliases: Isosurfaces Over Simplicial Partitions of Multiresolution Grids
definition: A method that extracts a manifold, intersection-free isosurface from a function over an arbitrary octree by partitioning space into simplices (tetrahedra) dual to minimal octree cells (vertices, edges, faces, cubes).
summary: Simplicial Partition Isosurfacing extracts manifold isosurfaces from octrees by partitioning space into dual simplices, guaranteeing non-self-intersecting topology unlike Dual Contouring or Dual Marching Cubes.
